description_en: Modifies the name, status, or description of a web filtering template. The template ID must belong to the current Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 修改Web过滤模板的名称、状态或描述信息。模板ID必须属于当前阿里云账号
name: UpdateWebFilterTemplate

parameters.help_en: The ID of the web filtering template to be modified. The template must exist within the current Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 要修改的Web过滤模板ID。必须为当前阿里云账号下已存在的模板
parameters.name: web_filter_template_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the web filtering template. The name must be 1 to 64 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, English letters, digits, hyphens (-), underscores (_), and periods (.). It cannot contain spaces. If this parameter is not specified or is left empty, the original value is retained
parameters.help_zh: Web过滤模板名称。长度为1~64个字符，支持中文、英文字母、数字、短划线（-）、下划线（_）和半角句号（.），不能包含空格。不传或传空时保持原值
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The status of the web filtering template. Valid values:
Enable: Enabled.
Disable: Disabled.
If this parameter is not specified or is left empty, the original value is retained
parameters.help_zh:
Web过滤模板的状态。取值：
Enable：开启。
Disable：关闭。
不传或传空时保持原值
parameters.name: status

parameters.example: 用于URL访问管控的Web过滤模板
parameters.help_en: The description of the web filtering template. The description can be up to 128 characters in length. If this parameter is not specified, the original value is retained. If an empty string is specified, the description is cleared
parameters.help_zh: Web过滤模板的描述信息。长度不超过128个字符。不传该参数时保持原值，传入空字符串时清空描述信息
parameters.name: description
